invalid_captures.reason: CUA targeted a separate process relaunched without diagnostic environment after observing a closed app. No input-stage or presentation samples were produced in the diagnostic process.

limitations: Host handler-to-present API timings exclude OS dispatch and physical display.
CUA mouse actions include AX observations between drags; this is not a physical mouse/pen benchmark.
Published counters exclude pending thread-local work, and capture endpoints may differ by a small number of boundary operations.
Source byte counters exclude cloned object/vector payloads, allocator overhead and unrelated GPU transfers.
Application defaults including recovery are retained; ordinary desktop background load is not isolated.
Compatibility control restores mask scans and full SVG tile rendering only; worker routing and copies are identical.

capture_recipe.api: cua native App.drag, full AX geometry observation after every move
capture_recipe.valid_trial_exclusion: No valid trial or slow sample excluded. One 46-drag setup block without any diagnostic samples was rejected before trial capture and repeated after resolving duplicate startup.

optimized_200_percent.scope: visual/geometry compatibility only; excluded from 50% latency trials

validation.scoped_whitespace: git diff --check of modified core/renderer/docs passed

diagnostic_sources_note: Compatibility mode restores full-object mask searches using collected references and full-layer SVG per dirty tile in this single binary. This is a focused diagnostic control, not a historical binary; two optimizations are evaluated together.
concurrent_workspace_note: Dependency/vendor changes from other work are preserved. This release uses Tauri 2.12.3 and its recorded Cargo.lock; prior-day/prior-turn release metrics used another artifact and are not mixed into this comparison.
